killedBy: run.mjs: the seams no vitest run can execute installs the AudioContext override before the gameplay navigation
why: Leaves the two real `AudioContext`s the app builds at boot -- Howler's, when `createAudioEngine` first touches `Howler.volume()`, and `engine.ts`'s `ensureCtx`. On a host whose audio service never connects each constructor returns only after an internal 20-second timeout, so the page blocks for ~40 s before `load` fires and `npm run gallery` wedges before it reaches gameplay. The gallery is how a renderer change is looked at at all, so this one is felt as "the tool is broken on my machine".
